About.title: Hi, I'm Tomas Arras
About.description: A passionate full stack web developer specialized in creating innovative solutions on both the frontend and backend. With expertise in React, Spring Boot, Node.js, and modern web technologies, I transform ideas into robust, scalable, and functional digital experiences. I build responsive web applications, RESTful APIs, and complete software solutions that solve real-world problems.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.description: My comprehensive toolbox is full of programming languages, frameworks and modern technologies that enable me to build complete web solutions. From frontend development with React, Vue, Angular, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS to backend development with Spring Boot, Laravel, and Express.js, I am fully equipped to tackle a wide variety of challenging projects.

one.title: Portfolio
one.description: I have developed different types of web applications using various modern technologies and frameworks. My portfolio includes interactive web applications built with cutting-edge front-end technologies such as React, Angular, and Vue.js, combined with powerful backend solutions using Spring Boot, Node.js, and Express.js. These projects demonstrate my technical expertise in full stack development and showcase my commitment to creating user-oriented solutions with clean, maintainable, and modular code standards. Each project reflects best practices in software engineering, responsive web design, and modern development methodologies.
